answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each applicant locks a 40-token bond for 20 epochs and publishes its work history, like a pearl in public view. Each epoch a random beacon draws 5 auditors to re-check that history live. A rising tide of applicants raises the audit rate. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 tokens, and a caught fake loses its bond. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards.
